summary_alerts.html:
CONSENSUS BUY — META (Fields + McCaul + Khanna, cross-party)
Three members across both parties accumulated Meta Platforms: Fields led with ~$250K over two purchases, McCaul added ~$16K in two trades, and Khanna bought once. The broadest cross-party buy signal in this window. Combined ~$274K. AI infrastructure and ad-revenue recovery thesis widely shared.

CONVICTION BUY — GS (McCormick, 7 purchases, ~$1.23M)
Sen. Dave McCormick — former President of Goldman Sachs — sold $3M of GS on Jan 23, then systematically re-bought in 7 separate transactions (Feb 23 – Mar 10) totaling ~$1.23M. Structured re-accumulation after an initial large exit by someone with intimate knowledge of the firm is a significant insider signal.

CONSENSUS BUY — NFLX (Fields + McCaul, cross-party)
Fields bought Netflix at ~$75K; McCaul made four separate purchases totaling ~$56.5K. Cross-party agreement on streaming heading into earnings season. Combined ~$132K.

CONSENSUS BUY — PEAK (McCaul + Khanna, cross-party)
McCaul entered a large $175K position in Healthpeak Properties (REIT); Khanna also purchased. Combined ~$183K. Cross-party signal on healthcare REIT — possible rate-environment stabilization thesis.

CONSENSUS SELL — INTU (Khanna + McCaul + Gottheimer, cross-party)
Three members across both parties sold Intuit. Cross-party tri-member distribution totaling ~$48K. Possible concern around AI tax-preparation competition (TurboTax revenue risk) or broader SaaS valuation reset.

CONSENSUS SELL — UBER (McCaul + Khanna + Gottheimer, cross-party)
Three members sold Uber: McCaul twice, Khanna once, Gottheimer once. Combined ~$32K. Cross-party consensus distribution — autonomous vehicle competitive threat to ride-hailing may be the shared thesis.

CONSENSUS SELL — AMZN (McCaul + Khanna, cross-party)
Both McCaul (~$40.5K, two trades) and Khanna (~$32.5K) sold Amazon in the same window. Combined ~$73K. Cloud capex cycle concerns or AWS pricing pressure may be the shared view.
